subtitle: GSR to the SBR. 3 minutes on foot. Nobody has ever made it.
intro: Arrows/WASD, tap to hop forward or swipe to hop any way. Reach the SBR at I2, First Court
restart: Click, tap or Space to try again from the GSR
facts: The GSR is on the second floor of 1 All Saints Passage, behind the Old Divinity School.
The GSR is for postgraduates only. Your Cam Card opens the door.
Cycle lanes in Cambridge are marked in red. Do not stand in them.
Cycling on the pavement is illegal in Cambridge. The cyclists have not read this.
Being caught without bike lights at night is a GBP50 fine.
The U bus is GBP1 with a University Card.
Buses 1 and 3 run from the station to the city centre.
Register your bike with the Porters to use the secure shed in Forecourt.
The SBR is in I staircase, First Court: through the Great Gate and turn left.
Parcels wait for you at the Great Gate Porters' Lodge.
The SBR room has a TV with a Wii, a pool table, a piano and board games.
The Samuel Butler Room was founded in 1960.

bike: Hit by a bike. It had no lights and no regrets.
A swarm of NatSci cyclists. They did not ring.
Flattened by a Dutch bike carrying a cello.
scooter: A delivery scooter. Your noodles arrived; you did not.
Hit by a scooter doing 30 in a 20. The food was still warm.
Run over by your own Deliveroo order.
bus: The U bus got you. At least it was GBP1.
The Citi 1 does not stop for postgraduates.
lawn: A Porter saw you on the grass. Escorted out through the Great Gate.
Keep off the grass. Only Fellows may walk on the lawn.
The lawn is for Fellows. You are being written up.
eagle: The St John's eagle got bored of waiting and carried you off.
Dawdled too long. The eagle from the crest has taken you to Ely.
Snatched by the eagle. It has a crown chained round its neck and a grudge.

eagleWarnText: The eagle is circling. Keep moving.
wins: Made it to the SBR! The Wii is broken. Back to the GSR for your charger.
SBR reached. Port & Sherry is not until Friday. Off you go again.
You made it. Someone took the last biscuit. Try again, faster.
SBR! Then you remembered you left your laptop in the GSR.
